RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 26, 2005/Sravana 4, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Credit rating system for small  and
medium scale enterprises
*21. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  he has launched the first
credit rating system  for small and medium
scale enterprises;
(b) if so, whether the move is aimed at
ensuring  higher availability of bank and
institutional credit to the small and medium
enterprises sector;
(c) whether the nodal agency for the
project would be the National Small
Industries Corporation; and
(d) if so, to what extent this rating
system has been helpful for the small and
medium enterprises?
Establishment of repair facilities
*22. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as a pre-condition to
placement of orders for Boeing/Airbus,
India  has sought  foreign investment in
civil aviation sector by establishing repair
overhaul and maintenance facilities in India;
(b) whether Boeing Airplane Co. and
Airbus Industrie have committed to invest
around Rs. 1,000.00 crores on Indian
facilities for maintenance, repair and
overhaul of their aircrafts in India; and
(c) whether around 150 Boeing aircrafts
are expected to be inducted by the Indian
carriers over the next three years and if so,
whether  financial viability of establishing
an MRO venture in India has been
confirmed?
US's concern over Indo-Iran pipeline
project
†*23. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indo-Pak-Iran pipeline
project has reached the crucial stage now;
(b) whether  United States of America
has expressed its disagreement about the
said project;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether any talks have been held
between him and U.S. Secretary of State in
this regard; and
(e) if so, the outcome of talks?

Pench Mega Project in Chhindwara
†*24. SHRIMATI  MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the proposal
of  Pench Mega Project in Chhindwara
district of Madhya Pradesh is pending  with
the Central Water Commission for
approval/release of investment amount for
many years;
(b) if so, by when this scheme will be
approved; and
(c) whether this scheme  is getting aid
from Indo-German Bilateral Development
Co-operative through its various schemes?
Committee to advise in cases against
companies
*25. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of COMPANY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
appointed a committee to aid and advise in
cases pending against 50,000 companies
for various violations;
(b) what kind of advice the committee
is expected to render; and
(c) whether any terms of reference have
been drawn up in this  regard and if so, the
details thereof?
Oil prices in international market
*26. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the rapidly increasing international oil
prices that have already touched the figure
of US$ 60 per barrel;
(b) whether the international oil prices
would further increase; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take in this regard and whether there is
adequate oil reserve in the country to face
any eventuality?
Deduction  of TDS from hospitals/
nursing homes
†*27. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN
DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that deducting
TDS from the payment to be made  by big
hospitals/nursing homes in private sector
and coaching institutes to the doctors,
teachers and professors is compulsory;
(b) the details of such big hospitals/
nursing homes and coaching institutes
which either did not  deposit the same
even after deducting TDS or did not deduct
itself; and
(c)  the action Government are taking to
recover the amount of TDS from these
institutions?
Programme on improvement of oil
sector
*28. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that a
comprehensive 17-Point programme has
been drawn up to improve the performance
of the oil sector to achieve long term oil
security for the country; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

present status of its implementation?

Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether  public sector companies
reduced the distribution of number of refilled
cooking gas cylinders in various districts
of Kerala recently;
(b) if s

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 26, 2005/Sravana 4, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 130
Tax exemption on leasing of aircrafts
99. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment of the impact of tax exemption
on the companies leasing new aircrafts;
(b) the loss  that has to be borne by IA
and AI on leasing out its  aircrafts to others:
and
(c) the total implication of this move in
the next five years on IA and AI?
Development of civil aviation in
Jammu and Kashmir and Orissa
100. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Rs. 14.05
crore is proposed to be spent in the civil
aviation sector in Jammu and Kashmir
region to promote tourism etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such a proposal is also
under consideration for the cash-strapped
Orissa State, which has a good potential
for tourism; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Expansion of air services
101. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of cities in the country
which are not connected by air services/
helicopter services;
(b) whether there is any proposal to start
new air services to the cities where no air
services are available;
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
such new air services would start;
(d) if not, the specific reasons therefor?
Discussion with Planning Commission
102. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:

25
(a) whether any discussions between his
Ministry and the Planning Commission
were held recently on various issues
concerning his Ministry apart from the
issue of under-capitalisation of AI and IA;
(b) if so, the details of discussions, held
with the Planning Commission; and
(c) what is the outcome of the
discussions so held?
Complaints on acquisition of aircrafts
103. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have received
complaints from certain MPs regarding
acquisition of fleet of aircrafts by Indian
Airlines and Air India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government have taken
thereon?
Scam in deployment of Private security
personnel at IGIA, Delhi
104. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CBI has
recently unearthed a scam in deployment
of private security personnel at Indira
Gandhi International Airport;
(b) if so, the details of the investigation;
and
(c) the names of the officials found
involved in the scam and the action taken
against them?
Regularisation of ground staff in IA
105. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the ground staff employed
in Indian Airlines have not been regularised
even after four years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the promotion of various
categories of ground staff employees is also
pending for a long time; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Air connectivity between important
cities
†106. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have taken several vital decisions for the
air connectivity of important cities;
(b) if so, the names of cities provided
with air connectivity in the last one year;
and
(c) the number of cities being
considered by Government for providing
air connectivity during the year 2005-06
alongwith the details thereof?
New international airport at Noida
†107. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to amend the prescribed
distance norms for international airports
and to construct a new international airport
at Noida in Uttar Pradesh; and
(b) if so, by when its construction is
targeted to be commenced?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

26
Coordination with IAF for use of air
space
108. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to use more air space which is
in the control of Indian Air Force by
coordinating with them;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Augmentation of infrastructure at
airports
109. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that private and
public sector airlines have placed orders
for purchase of a large number of
commercial aircrafts from different foreign
sources;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether airports in India have all
